continuity_scope: RuneScape 3's Murder on the Border quest as released on 20 March 2023, bounded to Jagex's 15 March official reveal roster and its 20 March launch/update notice. This is not an Old School RuneScape pass and does not merge other RuneScape 3 quests, later Fort Forinthry chapters, remasters, player-avatar biographies, or other live-service states.
work_or_witnesses: Jagex, New Quest: Murder On The Border, 15 March 2023, official guest profiles
Jagex, Murder On The Border & Graphical Updates - This Week In RuneScape, 20 March 2023, quest release/start notice
coverage_rule: All ten individually profiled guests/support NPCs in Jagex's official Murder on the Border reveal-table: King Roald Remanis III, Queen Ellamaria, Simon Bullace, Aster Dunnet, Bianca Dunnet, Duke Cole Augustus Hoarse, Lord Rodney Midas, Princess, Duchess Alba Hyett, and Lady Iris Ruthven. 'Princess' is included only as the title-designated pet-spaniel individual in this exact profile table. The player avatar/proprietor is excluded despite the quest's second-person framing. Named relations outside the roster (Roald II, Duke Horacio) are recorded only as contextual mentions, not endpoints.
omissions: The player-created adventurer/proprietor and every player-selected gender, name, appearance, skill level, fort construction, quest choice, clue assignment, investigation result, reward state, and murderer identification.

All named figures not individually profiled in the reveal table, including Roald II and Duke Horacio, despite contextual mentions; unprofiled guests, guards, monsters, gods, races, factions, items, areas, skills, quest systems, and mechanics as character nodes.
Old School RuneScape; every other RuneScape 3 quest, Fort Forinthry chapter, sequel, later patch/remaster/localization, books/adaptations, fan wikis, Wikipedia, walkthroughs, and community databases.
uncertainties: The direct official roster is a pre-launch promotional reveal (15 March) while the launch notice is dated 20 March. The reveal describes intended quest profiles and does not replace an exhaustive in-game transcript or solve the mystery.

Jagex explicitly says the murder mystery has an assigned murderer and asks players to use clues/character profiles. The culprit and any player-specific path are deliberately not recorded to avoid spoilers and choice/state overreach.
The quest requires variable fort-building and Construction prerequisites; the second-person proprietor/host is player-created and cannot be a stable node.

The update's post-release patch notes mention an edge case for a window associated with an assigned murderer, illustrating variant/player-state handling; it is boundary context rather than character evidence.

The source is English Jagex web copy and does not demonstrate identical localized game wording. RuneScape 3 and Old School RuneScape are kept separate; this record makes no shared-continuity assertion.
evidence_basis: Direct Jagex RuneScape news/reveal pages with named, per-character official profiles and a dated release notice. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, walkthrough, or community transcription is canonical evidence.
